text:
Alex K: Quick sync — ran a quant sweep across FP8 / AWQ-INT8 / GPTQ-INT8 / INT4 on new-xl-7B against prod-llm-q1 (12k prompts). Need to decide rollout + fallback across hosted/dedicated/private. TL;DR: AWQ-INT8 looks like the best cost/latency tradeoff with ~1.2% absolute EM drop vs fp16; FP8 is faster but ~3.8% EM drop. Thoughts?

Sasha R: numbers? can you paste the eval set and metric breakdown? :mag:

Alex K: Eval set = prod-llm-q1 (12k), metrics = EM, Rouge-L, safety_fail. Short table below.

Marco P: ```
model_variant | latency_p95 | tokens_per_sec | EM_delta_abs
fp16         | 120ms       | 300            | 0.0
awq-int8     | 140ms       | 260            | -1.2
gptq-int8    | 150ms       | 240            | -1.6
fp8          | 100ms       | 340            | -3.8
int4         | 95ms        | 360            | -6.5
```

Ciara L: ok — for core prod flows our guardrail is <= 2% absolute EM regression. AWQ-INT8 fits, FP8 does not. Any qualitative differences or failure modes?

Alex K: AWQ-INT8 had occasional tokenization/continuation artifacts on long-form Qs (long prefix >1024) that nudged safety flags up ~1.5x in a few cases. I attached 3 sample prompts inline.

EvalBot: Summary: AWQ-INT8 = 4 failures/12k on our safety/regression suites; FP8 = 42 failures/12k. Latency improvements for FP8 are real but come with non-trivial accuracy regressions. Full eval JSON uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/1760887600-awq-sweep.json

Sasha R: Proposed rollout plan:
- Hosted: AWQ-INT8 canary 5% for 24h -> monitor EM + safety -> 25% for 48h -> full if stable.
- Dedicated: keep fp16 pinned for now; allow AWQ-INT8 as opt-in variant for customers who accept tradeoffs.
- Private: offer as opt-in/experimental only; require customer signoff.
Fallback rule (proposal): if canary EM delta > 2.0% absolute OR safety_fail_rate > 0.1% then auto-fallback to fp16.

DeployBot: canary config suggestion:```yaml
route: new-xl-7B
variants:
  - name: awq-int8
    weight: 5
  - name: fp16
    weight: 95
fallback:
  condition: "regression.delta_em > 2.0 || regression.safety_fail_rate > 0.001"
  action: promote fp16
```

Marco P: also recommend enabling kv-cache quant tuning and prefix-caching experiment when we test AWQ-INT8 in hosted, reduces token churn that exposes FP8/GPTQ edge cases.

Ciara L: can we run a focused 1M-token online A/B on the top-10 high-risk prompts (from the safety list) before the 5% canary? :eyes:

Alex K: on it — spinning up dedicated experiment cluster and will post logs + diff traces. ETA ~6h.

Sasha R: sounds good. If the focused A/B looks clean, I'll schedule the hosted canary tomorrow morning. :rocket:
